title: The numbers behind 23 years of Perth solar.

paragraphs.text: Regen Power was founded in Perth in 2003 by Dr. Nikhil Jayaraj — one of Australia's first PhD-qualified renewable energy specialists. More than two decades later, we remain privately owned, Perth-based, and engineer-led.

That matters for one reason: when you call us after installation — about an app update, a Synergy feed-in query, a battery upgrade in 2030 — the team answering is the same team that designed your system.
